facts.fact: The 2025 median pay for barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists was $35,880 per year.
The median hourly wage for barbers was $18.37 in May 2025.
facts.quote: The median hourly wage for barbers was $18.37 in May 2025.

facts.fact: The median hourly wage for hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists was $17.21 in May 2025.
facts.quote: The median hourly wage for hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists was $17.21 in May 2025.

facts.fact: Barbers held about 75,800 jobs in 2025.
Hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists held about 595,000 jobs in 2025.
facts.quote: Hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists held about 595,000 jobs in 2025.

facts.fact: Self-employed workers accounted for 80% of barbers' largest employer category in 2025.
Self-employed workers accounted for 48% of hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists' largest employer category in 2025.
Personal care services employed 20% of barbers in 2025.
Personal care services employed 45% of hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists in 2025.
Retail trade employed 5% of hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists in 2025.
Overall employment of barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists is projected to grow 7 percent from 2025 to 2035.
facts.quote: Overall employment of barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists is projected to grow 7 percent from 2025 to 2035

facts.fact: Employment of barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists is projected to change by 48,400 from 2025 to 2035.
About 80,300 openings for barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists are projected each year, on average, over the decade.
facts.quote: About 80,300 openings for barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

facts.fact: All states require barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists to be licensed.
facts.quote: All states require barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists to be licensed.

facts.fact: The typical entry-level education for barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists is a postsecondary nondegree award.
In May 2025, the lowest 10 percent of barbers earned less than $13.75 per hour.
facts.quote: The lowest 10 percent earned less than $13.75, and the highest 10 percent earned more than $36.76.

facts.fact: In May 2025, the lowest 10 percent of hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists earned less than $13.00 per hour.
facts.quote: The lowest 10 percent earned less than $13.00, and the highest 10 percent earned more than $34.23.

facts.fact: In May 2025, the median hourly wage for barbers in personal care services was $18.26.
In May 2025, the median hourly wage for hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists in personal care services was $17.39.
In May 2025, the median hourly wage for hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists in retail trade was $14.84.
Licensing generally requires a state-specified minimum age, a high school diploma or equivalent, and graduation from a state-licensed barber or cosmetology school.
facts.quote: Generally, a person must meet state-specified minimum age requirements, have a high school diploma or equivalent, and have graduated from a state-licensed barber or cosmetology school.

facts.fact: Continuing education units (CEUs) may be required with periodic license renewals.
facts.quote: continuing education units (CEUs) may be required with periodic license renewals.

facts.fact: Barber, hairstylist, and cosmetologist wage figures include tips received from customers.
facts.quote: Barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists may receive tips from customers. These tips are included in the wage data shown.

facts.fact: BLS projects total employment of barbers, hairdressers, hairstylists and cosmetologists (SOC 39-5010) at 670,800 in 2025, rising to 719,200 in 2035.
BLS projects 2035 employment of barbers (SOC 39-5011) at 78,300, up from 75,800 in 2025.
BLS projects employment of hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists (SOC 39-5012) at 595,000 in 2025, rising to 640,900 in 2035.
BLS reports a 2025 median pay of $35,760 for manicurists and pedicurists, a similar occupation.
BLS reports a 2025 median pay of $45,330 for skincare specialists, a similar occupation.
BLS states that the Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) program produces employment and wage estimates annually for over 800 occupations.
facts.quote: produces employment and wage estimates annually for over 800 occupations

facts.fact: BLS notes that employment and projected employment change values in the projections table are rounded to the nearest 100 or percent.
facts.quote: Employment and projected employment change values are rounded to the nearest 100 or percent.
